create_CHMv2ImageProcessor: create a CHMv2ImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images and segmentation maps for the CHMV2 model
run_preprocess_images: run preprocess on input images and optional segmentation maps to produce pixel values and labels tensors
run_reduce_label: run reduce_label to shift segmentation map labels by 1, replacing background 0 with 255
test_resize_image: test resize on a torch tensor image to a target size with aspect ratio preservation and size divisor alignment
review_post_process_depth_estimation: review post_process_depth_estimation to convert raw DepthEstimatorOutput into final depth prediction tensors resized to target sizes
